verdicts.reason: Summary says it is "Anthropic's new phone-based personal agent for small businesses and busy professionals".
Summary praises "exceptional polish, intuitive design, task lists, artifacts, channels, and seamless cloud integrations", matching the main claim.
Summary says it "lacks sufficient proactivity, suffers from high latency that prevents timely task completion" and fails to engage users.
Summary says it "has no desktop app", which is the main claim, though single-player is not mentioned.
Summary concludes "it won't become the creator's primary agent despite its strong foundation", and calls it elegantly designed and functional.
